rationale: The agent located the user by name and ZIP and looked up multiple orders, but then executed several order-changing actions (canceling a pending order, modifying items in a pending order, and initiating a return) without first confirming each action with the user. The user also preferred to do one thing at a time, yet multiple actions were taken in one pass. There is no evidence the agent provided the tablet’s tracking number or addressed the refund/reorder request for the lost tablet, nor that a handoff occurred if it couldn’t be handled. The final response suggests completion without confirmation or summary. These issues violate the policy requirements to confirm before writes and to fulfill the user’s request accurately, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
